description:
The application seeks planning permission for a 
change of use from Class E to Mixed Use for restaurant and takeaway (Class E and Sui Generis). This application relates solely to that part of the unit for which a change of use is sought. The development description is: "Change of use from 
Class E to Mixed Use for restaurant and takeaway (Class E and Sui Generis). The proposed unit is shown edged in black on the submitted Site Location Plan (Drawing attached) and relates to the ground floor unit of the existing two storey building. The unit was most recently used Mega Sun Tanning Shop (Class E), but it was vacant for couple of months, and the proposed development was 
brought back into active use from January 14, 2023 (under current operation).
